deep.reconstruction:
This page has no mathematics. It is a pre-printed receipt form (Quittung) from Göttingen University, filled in by hand. Printed text is in Fraktur; handwritten insertions are marked [hs].

Full text: "Herr [hs: Professor Dr Riemann] erhalten an eingegangenem Honorar abschläglich die Summe von [hs: Zwanzig Thaler Gold]. Göttingen den [hs: 15]ten [hs: Mai] 18[hs: 58]." It is signed by hand at the lower right, small and faint, "B. Riemann." (the initial could also be read as L.). The folio number "30" is pencilled at the top right.

Translation: "Professor Dr Riemann has received, from lecture fees paid in, as a partial (installment) payment, the sum of twenty thaler in gold. Göttingen, 15 May 1858."

Context: 'Honorar' here means the student lecture fees (Kollegiengelder). These were collected by the university bursar (Quästur) and paid out to the lecturer, often in installments ('abschläglich'). Riemann's signature acknowledges receipt.

The title 'Professor' is consistent with his appointment as ausserordentlicher Professor in November 1857. The 1858 date, the sum and the gold denomination are plausible for the period. The neighbouring folios support the reading as a personal and administrative record:
- the previous folio shows a lecture-related note signed 'B. Riemann, Dr ph.' from his Privatdozent period;
- the next folio holds his lecture announcement (Vorlesungsanzeige) for Wintersemester 1858/59.

The page is a biographical document about Riemann's income and teaching. It contains no derivation to reconstruct.

results.what: Receipt for an installment of lecture fees (20 Thaler Gold) paid to Professor Dr Riemann, Göttingen, 15 May 1858
results.modern_name: Biographical/administrative document (Kollegiengeld receipt); no mathematical content

deep.surprise_reason: The page is a routine administrative receipt for lecture fees with no mathematical content. It is mildly useful biographically, documenting Riemann's fee income in summer 1858 and his title as Professor, but it would not surprise any historian.
transcription_corrections: Distinguish printed (Fraktur) from handwritten text. Printed: 'Herr', 'erhalten an eingegangenem Honorar abschläglich die Summe', 'von', 'Göttingen den', 'ten', '18'. Handwritten: 'Professor Dr Riemann', 'Zwanzig Thaler Gold', '15', 'Mai', '58'.
The '30' at the top right is a later pencil folio number, not part of the document.
The signature is small and faint. 'B. Riemann.' is plausible, but the initial could be misread as 'L.'; Riemann's B often has this form.
The date is written as '15ten Mai 1858'; the transcription is correct.
